t: How airport staff inspect the airfield each day and respond to hazards.

Status Active Expected result Airfield hazards are identified, addressed or communicated, and tracked through corrective action Audience Airport personnel responsible for daily airfield inspections, hazard response, NOTAMs, and follow-up Department Department of Public Works Unit Airport Operations Identifier AIRFIELD-INSPECTION-2026

1 Inspect airfield operating areas Conduct a daily inspection of runways, taxiways, aprons, lighting systems, signs, and safety areas. Responsible role Airfield inspector Completion criteria All listed operating areas and systems have been inspected. 2 Check for hazards and operational issues Inspect for Foreign Object Debris (FOD), wildlife activity, pavement damage, standing water during winter, obstructions, lighting issues, transient aircraft requiring tags, and conditions in hangar rows. Responsible role Airfield inspector Required record Daily inspection findings

1 Address hazards immediately when possible Correct or control identified hazards immediately when the condition can be safely addressed. Responsible role Airfield inspector 2 Issue required NOTAMs Issue NOTAMs for conditions that may affect aircraft operations. Responsible role Authorized airport personnel Completion criteria Affected aircraft operators can receive timely notice of the condition. 3 Notify Airport Management Notify Airport Management of significant safety concerns. Responsible role Airfield inspector 4 Track corrective action to completion Follow up on identified hazards until corrective action is completed. Responsible role Airfield inspector Airport Management Completion criteria The corrective action is complete and the hazard no longer affects safe operation.

Airfield inspector Conducts daily inspections, identifies hazards, addresses conditions when possible, issues or initiates required notifications, and follows up. Airport Management Receives significant safety notifications and supports corrective action.
Record type Airfield inspection and corrective-action records Requirement The source requires inspection and follow-up but does not state a retention period.
